## About Me
Hi! My name is **Jeffrey Flores**, a grad student at Baruch pursuing an 
***M.S. in Statistics***. Recently, I graduated with a bachelors in 
***Statistics & Quantitative Modeling *** with a minor in Communication Studies.
I'm intertested in leveraging my skills within the sports industry and hope to 
one day contribute to a teams' success through data. This website will serve as a
portfolio to showcase my course projects in STA9750.
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if(!require("leaflet")){
    options(repos=c(CRAN="https://cloud.r-project.org"))
    install.packages("leaflet")
    stopifnot(require("leaflet"))
}

baruch_longitude <- -73.98333
baruch_latitude  <- +40.74028

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, zoom=17) |>
  addPopups(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, 
            "I am a Master's student at <b>Baruch College</b>!")
```
